name: Discord
description: Your Discord call as a fireteam on the island (who's talking, each person's volume, mute, deafen, leave, rejoin), @mentions as notifications and pings, what you're listening to on your status, and a Command Center sheet of its own: your servers and voice channels to join, Discord's voice settings, your status and your pings.
talksTo: The Discord app on this PC (its local connection)
discord.com, to sign in with the Discord application you make
Apple's iTunes Search, for the album art on your status (title and artist)
